Business Analyst salary in South Carolina

Based on 21 current job listings that show pay on Fortune Jobs AI (updated November 24, 2026), listed pay for Business Analyst jobs in South Carolina is $81,243–$120,000 a year (middle 50% of listed salary midpoints). The median listed midpoint is about $96,720 a year. These figures describe listed pay in current postings, not a salary survey. Hourly and yearly figures are not mixed or extrapolated.

Frequently asked questions

What is typical listed pay?

The median listed salary midpoint is about $96,720 a year across 21 current postings. The middle 50% is $81,243–$120,000 a year.

Which employers list the highest pay?

Cynet Systems: about $130,000 a year (median of 4 listings); Maximus: about $100,000 a year (median of 5 listings); Innosoft Corporation: about $90,000 a year (median of 3 listings); State of South Carolina: about $76,500 a year (median of 2 listings); CGI: about $51,600 a year (median of 2 listings). Only employers with at least two usable listings of the same pay unit are compared.

Is this a salary survey?

No. The figures are listed pay in current job postings on Fortune Jobs AI, not a salary survey or a prediction of an offer. Listings without usable pay are excluded.
